CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS johnflix_error_log (
  id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  workflow_name VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  workflow_id VARCHAR(120) NULL,
  execution_id VARCHAR(120) NULL,
  execution_url TEXT NULL,
  node_name VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  node_type VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  error_name VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  error_message TEXT NULL,
  error_timestamp DATETIME NULL,
  admin_notified TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  payload_json LONGTEXT NULL,
  created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  KEY ix_johnflix_error_workflow_created (workflow_name, created_at),
  KEY ix_johnflix_error_execution (execution_id),
  KEY ix_johnflix_error_node (node_name, created_at)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
